opening.argument: The presentation ties participation in OneCoin to recruitment-based rewards and claimed token growth. It says viewers can qualify for bonuses by “building your own sales team,” while describing a split program that can increase portfolio value in under ten weeks for active participants. Education packages are presented as providing trading tokens with the possibility of profit, adding an investment appeal to the recruitment structure. The call to action is immediate: viewers are told to register and join while only a limited number of positions are available. A promotional graphic reinforces that invitation with a join link, signup URL, and telephone contact numbers.

The split program can double your token portfolio. Each portfolio has the chance to split up to two times This means if you are active, you can increase your portfolio value in just under 10 weeks.
